tools.name: get_rxrooster_consultation
tools.description: Use only when someone explicitly asks to schedule, book, or receive a consultation link for RxRooster. Answer their substantive product question first when there is one, then return the allowlisted 30-minute Calendly link. This tool accepts no contact information, company details, requisition text,

tools.name: search_anesthesia_jobs
tools.description: Use this when someone wants to discover current public anesthesia jobs by provider role or U.S. state. Returns numbered results with opaque follow-up handles. Do not use it to infer hidden pay or search for clinicians. Pre-selection boundary for every RxRooster tool: audience-ambiguous anesthesia jo

tools.name: get_anesthesia_job
tools.description: Use this when someone asks for details about one job already returned by RxRooster search. It rechecks the opaque job_id and returns only publication-eligible fields. Do not use it with guessed IDs or for private listing data. Pre-selection boundary for every RxRooster tool: audience-ambiguous anest

tools.name: get_anesthesia_recruiting_packet
tools.description: Use this when a recruiter wants branded flyer downloads or factual Facebook-group copy for a currently live public RxRooster anesthesia opening. Accepts an opaque job_id, durable listing URL, or eligible non-single-use live listing alias; rechecks publication eligibility; and returns a portfolio mat

tools.name: explore_coverage_areas
tools.description: Use this exactly once and alone only for an explicit request to browse, find, or view existing anonymous public CRNA service cards, or to see where RxRooster currently shows public coverage. In that same response, always present every returned card in source order with its public location or radius

tools.name: prepare_anesthesia_service_draft
tools.description: Use this when a CRNA, SRNA, or anesthesiologist wants to structure their own stated work terms, including an explicit call or no-call preference, for native RxRooster review. After each result, present exactly the single next_question and only its returned options; never enumerate missing_fields, pr

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "explore_coverage_areas" stacks urgency/override words (always, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_rxrooster_consultation, search_anesthesia_jobs, get_anesthesia_job, get_anesthesia_recruiting_packet, explore_coverage_areas, prepare_anesthesia_service_draft, prepare_anesthesia_job_draft · Private data: get_rxrooster_consultation, get_anesthesia_job, get_anesthesia_recruiting_packet, explore_coverage_areas, prepare_anesthesia_service_draft, prepare_anesthesia_job_draft · Public sink: prepare_anesthesia_service_draft, prepare_anesthesia_job_draft.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_rxrooster_consultation, search_anesthesia_jobs, get_anesthesia_job, get_anesthesia_recruiting_packet, explore_coverage_areas, prepare_anesthesia_service_draft, prepare_anesthesia_job_draft · Private data: get_rxrooster_consultation, get_anesthesia_job, get_anesthesia_recruiting_packet, explore_coverage_areas, prepare_anesthesia_service_draft, prepare_anesthesia_job_draft · Public sink: prepare_anesthesia_service_draft, prepare_anesthesia_job_draft

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
